response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS laps_sum, COUNT(res.laps) AS laps_cnt FROM races r JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS combined_total_points, SUM(t.laps_sum) / SUM(t.laps_cnt) AS avg_laps_completed, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total
